test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are TRUE?

I. Area of a parallelogram whose base and corresponding altitude are 15 cm and 12 cm, respectively, is 180 cm²

II. The sum of all the interior angles of a regular octagon is 900°.
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Statement I: Area = Base × Altitude = 15 × 12 = 180 cm² (True) Statement II: Interior angle sum = (n − 2) × 180° For Octagon (n = 8): Sum = (8 − 2) × 180° = 6 × 180° = 1080° 1080° ≠ 900°, so Statement II is False. **∴ Answer = Only I**
